usedFor: Ecwid holds the store's orders, products and customers, and Bolna places the call about them through “Make a Phone Call”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Updated” in Ecwid, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: An order change is a reason to reach the customer, and the action makes the phone call.

watchOut: “Order Updated” fires on every update, so one order can start “Make a Phone Call” more than once.
